meta.title: Flashcards that ask a new question at every review
meta.description: LearnForge rewrites each card's question when it is due, tracks how deeply you know it and schedules reviews with FSRS. It imports Anki decks with their schedule and is open source.

hero.hook: Flashcards that ask a new question at every review.
hero.subtitle: Bring your Anki decks with their schedule. LearnForge rewrites each card's question when it is due and asks one level higher once you keep getting it right.
hero.ctaNote: No credit card. €4.99 a month afterwards. The rewritten questions run on your Claude account or on your own API key.

demo.title: One card, asked three ways
demo.lead: Tap an answer. It is the same card each time, with a different question.
demo.caption: Example card. In LearnForge, Claude writes such questions from your own cards, in Claude chat or in the app with an API key.

reviews.label: First review
reviews.stem: What causes the seasons on Earth?
options: Earth's changing distance from the Sun
The Sun shining brighter and dimmer
reviews.explain: Earth's axis is tilted by about 23.5 degrees. Over a year each half of the planet leans towards the Sun, then away from it.

reviews.label: Later
reviews.stem: Why is it summer in Australia while it is winter in Austria?
options: Australia is closer to the Sun
The southern half of Earth is tilted towards the Sun at that time
The days in Australia are longer all year
reviews.explain: When the north leans away from the Sun, the south leans towards it. Sunlight hits the south more steeply and for more hours a day.

reviews.label: Later still
reviews.stem: A planet circles its star with an axis that is not tilted. What are its seasons like?
options: Hot summers and cold winters, as on Earth
The same as on Earth, but twice as long
There are almost none: every place gets the same sunlight all year
reviews.explain: Without a tilt neither half ever leans towards the star. Each place gets the same sunlight every day of the year, so nothing changes with the seasons.

review.title: What happens when a card is due
review.lead: See the same card often enough and you start to recognise the card instead of recalling the idea. LearnForge changes the question, so that shortcut stops working.

variation.title: The question is rewritten
variation.description: By default each review rewords the question and moves it to a slightly different setting. You set how far that goes per card or per topic.
stepHints: Same idea in a new situation

levels.title: Every card has a level
levels.description: There are six levels, from recalling a fact to building something with it. Keep answering well and the card moves up a level. Miss it and it steps back. Cards set to Exact stay on their level.

answers.title: Tap, type or dictate
answers.description: Pick a session difficulty and how you want to answer. Open answers are graded, and you can ask follow-up questions afterwards. All of this needs the tutor: Claude chat, or the app with your own API key.

schedule.title: FSRS decides when
schedule.description: The FSRS algorithm schedules every card from how you rated it. After harder sessions and more varied questions, the next interval is longer.

anki.title: Import from Anki
anki.description: Upload an .apkg or .colpkg file from a current or older Anki version. Decks and media come along, and you choose whether to keep your schedule. Image occlusion cards come along too, ready to study.

claude.title: Create them in Claude chat
claude.description: Connect LearnForge to Claude and say what you are learning. Claude drafts cards with formulas, diagrams and cloze gaps, and saves them once you approve.

editor.title: Write them yourself
editor.description: Write and edit cards in the web app. No AI involved.

share.title: Get a topic by link
share.description: A link from someone else copies a whole topic with its cards into your account. Your progress starts at zero.

where.title: Two places to study, and what each costs
where.lead: The LearnForge subscription pays for hosting. AI usage is separate, and you choose how to cover it.

chat.title: In Claude chat
points: Claude asks the questions and grades your answers
No API key needed, it runs on your Claude account
Set up once: paste the LearnForge address into Claude's settings (Claude calls this a connector)

points: A web app you can add to your phone's home screen
The built-in tutor needs an API key: a code from your own Anthropic developer account, billed by usage

items.a: LearnForge is an open-source flashcard app with spaced repetition. When a card is due, an AI tutor rewrites its question, the app tracks one of six levels of understanding per card, and the FSRS algorithm plans the next review.

items.q: Do I need a Claude subscription or an API key?
items.a: For studying in Claude chat you need a Claude account with LearnForge added as a connector, and no API key. For the tutor inside the LearnForge app you need your own Anthropic API key, which Anthropic bills by usage. With neither you can still study your cards in the app and rate yourself.

items.q: Can I bring my Anki decks?
items.a: Yes. LearnForge imports .apkg and .colpkg files from current and older Anki versions. Decks and media come along, and you choose whether to keep the schedule of every card. Image occlusion cards come along too, ready to study.

items.q: Does the question really change every time?
items.a: By default, yes: each review rewords the question and moves it to a slightly different setting. You can set a card or a topic to Exact, and then it is asked word for word. In the app, cards that depend on a picture or a formula are shown as they are, and without an API key you see every card as it is.

The first 30 days are free and need no credit card. After that the hosted version costs €4.99 a month, or €48 a year. Self-hosting is free under the AGPL-3.0 licence. AI usage is billed separately by Anthropic.
They follow Bloom's Taxonomy: Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate and Create. Each card has its own level. It goes up when you keep answering well and steps back when you miss.
